entities.name: Boc deprotection
observations: The substrate's bicyclic amine bears N-C(=O)O-tert-butyl; product has the deprotected amine. Formula difference is C5H8O2, consistent with Boc removal and N-H formation.

entities.name: Acidic Boc cleavage
observations: Common conditions include trifluoroacetic acid in dichloromethane or hydrogen chloride in dioxane/ethyl acetate; these are plausible options, not identified experimentally for this reaction.
